verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs describe several first-party self-hosting paths: the Linux package for low-configuration install, official Docker images, Helm chart/Operator for cloud-native installs, self-compilation, and recommended scaling configurations. Self-Managed instances are a documented deployment target, including instance-level Agent Platform controls. Community reports corroborate running private and self-hosted instances and describe GitLab's open-source core as forkable, though one user hit backup breakage on a self-hosted upgrade. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that every AI/agent capability works on self-managed instances, and a clear statement of which features in the open-source core versus paid tiers can be self-hosted.
